security_problem: Canonical registry runners (npx, uvx, bunx, pnpx, pnx, npm exec, npm x, yarn dlx, pnpm dlx, bun x, uv tool run) select executable package bytes from a registry or package cache at runtime; a local package-manager binary plus a literal package spec does not bind the artifact that will execute, so launcher+literal-argv hashing must not satisfy attestation.
required_behavior: A configured stdio invocation digest binds a locally resolved launcher executable and local payload file content selected by the args, and is checked before all argument-dependent authorization and relay; every recognized canonical registry-runner form (npx, uvx, bunx, pnpx, pnx, npm exec, npm x, yarn dlx, pnpm dlx, bun x, uv tool run) fails identity resolution and reaches the configured-attestation fail-closed gate before argument policy or relay; exact non-registry subcommands (npm run, npm run x, npm install, npm ci, yarn add, pnpm add, pnpm exec, bun run, bun add, uv run, uv tool install) remain resolvable; mismatch or unresolved identity denies with identity-bound audit evidence.
failure_behavior: Fail closed for tools/call when attestation is configured and identity resolution is missing, unsupported, or mismatched.
